info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Seafood Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Seafood Recliner Catalog Management API enables users to add new details to the seafood recliner catalog. This API is essential for managing product information, including specifications, features, and availability. Retailers and inventory systems can utilize this endpoint to ensure that the latest product offerings are accurately reflected in their catalogs. Perfect for eCommerce platforms and inventory management applications, this API supports streamlined updates and enhances the customer's shopping experience.

post.summary: Create a new seafood recliner detail
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new detail entry for a seafood recliner, enabling users to specify attributes and characteristics to enhance their browsing experience.
